case.title: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.. Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red. Need: 15900 pc a year. Category goal: quality first: defects and late deliveries cost more than a few cents of price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 58 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200011. Must-haves: ppm_commitment <= 1500. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for your quote and your willingness to prove your reliability. Defects have improved modestly, but the proposed quality commitment would allow deterioration rather than the operational recovery we need.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).

Every package removes complaint chargebacks to make complaint exposure predictable, and we are flexible on the quality commitment: Option C allows more quality headroom in exchange for a lower price. Which option works best for you and can be backed by a binding, evidenced recovery plan?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 43.78 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option B: EUR 43.55 per unit, quality commitment 800 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option C: EUR 43.24 per unit, quality commitment 1500 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

We recognise that our late payments have added cash pressure, and we value working towards dependable performance together.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Thanks for mentioning the late payments - cash is super tight for us right now, so we really need you to pay on time. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. 

We hear you on the quality and 1500 ppm is a tough target, but we are ready to roll up our sleeves and commit to it. Our Angebot is a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. We can drop the price to €46.00 for the 1500 ppm option with zero chargebacks, giving an alternative of a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 1500 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

We value our relationship and look for a reciprocal step that helps turn the reported corrective work into reliable supply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
